description: This file defines a React component 'ExploreMindmapCanvas' which renders an interactive SVG-based mind map visualization. It includes type definitions for nodes, edges, viewport, and props, as well as layout and label wrapping utility functions.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Limits a number between specified minimum and maximum values.

methods.name: wrapLabel
methods.description: Wraps text into multiple lines with max characters per line and max lines.

methods.name: computeRadialLayout
methods.description: Calculates node positions in a radial layout for the mind map.
